items.title: 1.2 Introduction to Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) ek framework (dhancha) hai jo batata hai ke organizations (idare) kisi application ko shuru ke khayal (initial conception) se le kar us ki deployment aur maintenance tak kin processes se banati hain. SDLC ka sab se bara maqsad aisa high-quality software dena hai jo customer ki tawaqqo (expectations) poori kare ya us se bhi behtar ho, diye gaye waqt aur kharche (time and cost estimates) ke andar mukammal ho, aur efficiently (achi tarah, kam wasail mein) kaam kare.

blocks.prompt: SDLC ka sab se bara (primary) maqsad kya hai? (Exercise MCQ 1)
blocks.explanation: High-quality software dena jo waqt aur kharche ke andaze ke andar mukammal ho aur customer ki tawaqqo poori kare: option (b).

items: SDLC: application ko khayal se deployment aur maintenance tak banane ke processes ka framework.
Maqsad: high-quality software, waqt aur kharche ke andar, efficiently kaam karta hua.
